How far apart an account's two dates may be and still mean "never in"

report_tolerance.Rd

Sixty seconds, decided on 2026-10-15 after one measurement: an account the round created on 2026-10-08 carried createdDateTime and lastPasswordChangeDateTime equal to the second six days later, and its person said they had not signed in yet. The key is born in the call that makes the account, so the two dates differ only by what Entra takes to write them; the round creates every account with the change of key forced at first sign-in, so a person who has signed in has moved the second date.

Usage

report_tolerance()

Value

Seconds.

Details

Confirmed on 2026-10-16 over the enabled accounts of the tenant: the accounts known never to have been used sit at 0 seconds, none falls between 1 and 30, a handful between 31 and 120; an account made by hand on the portal and used once sits at 172.

One value, in one place: a later measurement changes it in one line.
